title_zh: v197：full-DCT K2 被独立确认为仅供未来使用的合格参考
title_en: v197: full-DCT K2 is independently qualified as a future-only adequate reference
scientific_question: Can the already sealed full-DCT K2 endpoint be fixed, without substitution, as an adequate reference for candidate contracts frozen after v197 on the same opened p22 roster?

reference_identity.name: full_dct_k2_future_reference
reference_identity.refinement: exactly two unchanged strict CGLS iterations

interpretation_zh: v197 解决的是实验合同问题：full-DCT K2 在五相机和九相机两臂合计 2626/2626 个严格单元、26/26 个完整标定组全部通过，且最小严格单元裕量仍为正。它现在可作为 v197 之后另行冻结候选的固定参考。
interpretation_en: v197 resolves an experimental-contract problem: full-DCT K2 passes all 2626/2626 strict cells and all 26/26 complete calibration groups across the five-camera and all-nine arms, with a positive minimum strict-cell margin. It may now serve as the fixed reference for separately frozen candidates after v197.
decision_boundary_zh: 这是结果后选择、仅供未来使用的参考资格，不会回头改变 v196 的 inconclusive 判决，也不是候选算法、紧凑初始化器、调用减少或速度结果。下一步只能在读结果前冻结一个物理上不同的新候选，并保留同一绝对门、固定参考、便宜对照、调用账与独立第二实现。
decision_boundary_en: This is a post-result, future-only reference qualification. It does not revise the inconclusive v196 verdict and is not a candidate algorithm, compact initializer, call-reduction result, or speed result. The next step is to freeze one physically distinct candidate before reading its results while retaining the same absolute gates, fixed reference, cheap controls, call ledger, and independent second implementation.
